adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Major weight loss followed by postprandial pain, bilious vomiting, proximal dilation and CT compression of the third duodenum between the SMA and aorta is superior mesenteric artery syndrome.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: MALS compresses the celiac artery, nutcracker syndrome compresses the left renal vein, annular pancreas is congenital, and gastroparesis lacks focal duodenal vascular compression.
